user.title: Integration Pins
user.description: Adds an 'Integration Pins' sidebar panel for running a specific release's copy of a core integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

pin_out_of_range.title: Pinned integration {domain} is outside its core range
pin_out_of_range.description: The override for `{domain}` was copied from Home Assistant {pinned_version} and marked valid for core versions `{core_range}`. You are now running {core_version}. The pinned code is still being loaded. Open the Integration Pins panel to widen the range if it still works, or unpin it to go back to the bundled version (restart required).

pin_missing.title: Pinned integration {domain} has no override directory
pin_missing.description: A pin for `{domain}` (Home Assistant {pinned_version}) is recorded, but `custom_components/{domain}` no longer exists, so the bundled version is what is running. Re-pin it from the Integration Pins panel (for a pin uploaded from a folder, pick its folder again) or remove the pin.

pin_not_aliased.title: Integrations built on {domain} are not running its pin
pin_not_aliased.description: The pin for `{domain}` (Home Assistant {pinned_version}) is running, but `homeassistant.components.{domain}` was imported before it loaded, so integrations that import from `{domain}` use the bundled code beside the pin. Home Assistant imports some integrations, such as `http`, `recorder` and `sensor`, before any custom integration loads, and a pin of one of those can never reach its importers. For any other, something that does not wait for `{domain}` to set up imported it first. Unpin it if the pin was meant to change what those integrations get.

pin_foreign.title: Override for {domain} was not written by Integration Pins
pin_foreign.description: `custom_components/{domain}` exists but does not carry the marker for the pin recorded here (Home Assistant {pinned_version}). Something else replaced it. Re-pin from the Integration Pins panel to restore the recorded version (for a pin uploaded from a folder, pick its folder again), or adopt the directory as-is. Unpinning removes only the pin and leaves the directory alone.

foreign_directory_not_confirmed.message: custom_components/{domain} holds {name} {version}, which Integration Pins did not install. Pinning moves it to {retired_dir}/; confirm to go ahead.
